title: FC 5805: Use
officialText:
5805.1 General.

Flammable gases in amounts exceeding the maximum allowable quantity per control area indicated in FC Table 5003.1.1(1) or 5003.1.1(3) shall be used in accordance with FC 5001, 5003 and 5005, and this chapter.
